lyrics_set.lyrics:
[Intro]
[Verse]
Salt hangs heavy in the midnight air
I watch the gray waves start to flare
The pier is stretching toward the deep
While secrets in the undertow sleep
[Pre-Chorus]
The horizon pulls my spirit wide
I find the strength to turn the tide
[Chorus]
You are the anchor in my chest
The steady ground where my shadows rest
A constant hum in the crashing blue
Every beat of my heart beats for you
[Verse]
The wind is howling a lonely tune
Under the gaze of a silver moon
I am drifting where the currents collide
With nowhere left for my soul to hide
[Pre-Chorus]
The horizon pulls my spirit wide
I find the strength to turn the tide
[Chorus]
You are the anchor in my chest
The steady ground where my shadows rest
A constant hum in the crashing blue
Every beat of my heart beats for you
[Instrumental]
[Bridge]
No more drifting, no more chase
I find my home in your steady space
[Chorus]
You are the anchor in my chest
The steady ground where my shadows rest
A constant hum in the crashing blue
Every beat of my heart beats for you
[Outro]
